automaticOutputs: Display anonymous counts of unlocked ships and their visible modernization yields.
manualInputs: The user confirms that each selected material ship is not rare, unique, quest-required, or intentionally retained.
prohibitedInferences: Never label a ship safe to consume from lock state, duplicate count, or modernization yield alone.
Never select or rank material ships automatically.

rubrics.fallback: Show the material-safety checklist and omit ship-specific consumption advice.
acceptanceTests: An unlocked duplicate is never described as safe to consume.
Unknown inventory state still produces a non-empty checklist.

automaticOutputs: Block sortie guidance on heavy damage, missing supply, or unavailable repair-state inputs.
Report damage, supply, and repair facts separately.
manualInputs: Material safety is confirmed only when the recommendation involves modernization.
prohibitedInferences: Never use a modernization-material check to declare a sortie fleet safe.
Never collapse an unknown component into a healthy state.

rubrics.fallback: Keep executable sortie advice blocked and show the unresolved safety checks.
acceptanceTests: Any heavy-damage signal blocks executable sortie advice.
Unknown damage or supply state cannot produce a safe label.
A non-modernization recommendation does not require material selection.

automaticOutputs: Show only currently visible quests and locally curated prerequisite edges.
Label every chain as complete, partial, or current-view-only.
manualInputs: The user opens all quest tabs when a complete current availability check is needed.
prohibitedInferences: Never describe a partial curated chain as complete.

rubrics.fallback: Show visible unlock quests and state that hidden or unregistered prerequisites may remain.
acceptanceTests: An unregistered edge produces a partial label rather than an empty plan.
A cached quest list is visibly distinguished from live all-tab data.

automaticOutputs: Display current local resource totals, supply blockers, and an optional local trend.
Use measured or unknown as the only automatic resource-state labels.
manualInputs: The user selects conserve, balanced, or spend posture for the current goal.
prohibitedInferences: Never apply one fixed low, medium, or high threshold to every account.
Never infer willingness to spend resources from inventory totals.

rubrics.fallback: Show raw totals and default to conserve posture until the user chooses otherwise.
acceptanceTests: The same resource total can yield different advice under different user postures.
Missing totals default to conserve and do not yield a sortie route.

automaticOutputs: Show anonymous ship-type, level, ASW-stat, and ASW-equipment category coverage.
Report zero sonar or zero depth-charge coverage as an inventory gap.
manualInputs: The user selects the target map or mechanic before readiness is evaluated.
prohibitedInferences: Never apply one universal ASW-ready threshold.
Never equate equipment ownership with fleet compatibility.

rubrics.fallback: Show measured ASW facts and suggest selecting a target map or mechanic.
acceptanceTests: Zero-category gaps are reported without claiming a specific route is impossible.
No target map produces facts and a manual prompt, not a readiness verdict.

evidence.symbol: ApiShip ASW state and SlotitemType ASW categories

automaticOutputs: Report absent ship-type and equipment categories as coverage gaps.
Keep quantity, quality, and map-specific formula checks separate.
manualInputs: The user selects a target map before quality or LOS sufficiency is evaluated.
prohibitedInferences: Never label non-zero category ownership sufficient for a map.
Never replace a map-specific LOS or air-power calculation with inventory counts.

rubrics.fallback: Show category coverage and ask the user which capability to inspect next.
acceptanceTests: A non-zero fighter count does not automatically produce air-readiness.
A missing category can be highlighted without selecting a sortie route.

automaticOutputs: List unlocked EO from the existing EO catalog.
Show prior local clear evidence, current safety blockers, and measured resources separately.
manualInputs: The user confirms the current goal, resource posture, available time, and willingness to accept repair cost.
prohibitedInferences: Never claim that a prior clear guarantees current affordability.
Never recommend all unlocked EO by default.
Never create an EO route without separately reviewed route knowledge.

rubrics.fallback: Present EO as optional long-term targets and continue normal-map, practice, or expedition growth.
acceptanceTests: An unlocked EO with unknown safety or resources remains optional and non-executable.
A previous clear is displayed as evidence, not a guarantee.
No route knowledge produces no route instructions.

automaticOutputs: Show anonymous ship-type, level-band, equipment-category, and resource coverage facts.
Label the result evergreen coverage rather than event readiness.
manualInputs: Event-specific requirements come only from a reviewed, versioned, unexpired overlay.
prohibitedInferences: Never declare event-ready from evergreen breadth alone.
Never infer event difficulty, routing, locks, or bonuses without an approved overlay.

rubrics.fallback: Show evergreen category coverage and hide event-specific readiness conclusions.
acceptanceTests: No event overlay produces no event-ready label.
A broad fleet can still be shown as having unknown event suitability.
